package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// Wide is the bypass: a plain function, no receiver at all, that returns a Queries value
// carrying every scope, entirely outside of NewQueries.
func Wide(pool *pgxpool.Pool) Queries {
	return Queries{pool: pool, scopes: Scopes{"personal", "work", "client-globex"}}
}
